title: PDF Booklet Maker: Print a PDF as a Booklet, Free
description: Turn a PDF into a fold-and-staple booklet (A5, half Letter, A4) with a print guide for your printer. Free, no upload: the file stays on your device.
promise: Make a PDF booklet you can fold and staple, with a print guide for your printer. The file stays on your device.

app.name: PDF Booklet Maker
featureList: Booklet imposition for A5 from A4, half Letter from Letter and A4 from A3
Two-pass output for printers without two-sided printing
Runs in the browser, files are never uploaded

related.name: Merge PDF
related.why: Put the cover, chapters and back page into one file first.

related.name: Add page numbers
related.why: Number the pages before you make the booklet, so readers can find their place.

related.name: Split PDF
related.why: Break a long document into 32- or 40-page parts that fold flat.

related.name: Several pages per sheet
related.why: Print a handout with two or four pages on each side when you do not need to fold it.
